messages:
Olivia CSM: Heads-up — PulseLane renewal in 3 weeks. Customer asked for a short-form security attestation + proof of data deletion for a scoped dataset. Can we assemble something by EOD Friday? @maria_cs can you own the evidence bundle? :calendar:
maria_cs: I can own. Thinking doc list: 1) SOC2 cert pdf, 2) data-flow diagram, 3) deletion SOP excerpt, 4) redacted deletion audit export, 5) brief attestation letter. Need eng to pull export and privacy/legal signoff for sharing deletion info. @sam_engineer, ETA on log/export work?
sam_engineer: I can pull the deletion audit. Need tenant id + time range. FYI deletion events are in prod_events.deleted_rows. Example query I’ll run:
```sql
SELECT * FROM prod_events.deleted_rows
WHERE tenant_id = 'pulselane-XXXXX'
AND ts BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2025-02-01';
```
If they want row-level details we must run during a DB ops window — otherwise I’ll supply a redacted export. ETA 48h after tenant id + timeframe.
liam_privacy: Ok to share a redacted deletion audit plus an attestation paragraph referencing our DPA. We must redact personal identifiers; UUIDs are fine. Recommend we include retention policy excerpt and deletion SOP snippet too.
Omar (Legal): Confirmed. Redacted audit + attestation is acceptable. I’ll draft a short attestation paragraph that references SOC2 scope and DPA section 4.2. If any PI is present we need to record the redaction approach. Please send me the redaction script or sample.
onboard-bot: Attached: /evidence/soc2/2025/soc2_cert_pulselane.pdf (sha256:abc123def456) and /evidence/policies/data-retention_v1.2.pdf (sha256:fedcba654321).
Olivia CSM: Great — action items: maria -> assemble docs; sam -> run query & produce redacted CSV + note; liam -> approve redaction; Omar -> write attestation paragraph. Target delivery: Friday 1800 PT. Any objections?
maria_cs: No objections, starting collection now. I’ll also draft the cover email.
sam_engineer: Quick Q — to redact I propose script: replace user_email and user_id with hashed placeholders and remove ip_address column. If they insist on row-level IDs we’ll need a DB ops window and +24h. Recommend redacted export + attestation.
liam_privacy: That redaction plan works. Please include a short line in the attestation that we redacted personal identifiers and retained UUID traces only.
Olivia CSM: Perfect. I’ll tell PulseLane we’ll deliver a redacted audit + attestation + policy excerpts by Friday 6pm PT. Thanks all :thumbsup:
